thread:
matt: starting a small config-only rollout now (change window: 20m). canary=5% across us-west/eur-west, geo-weight tweak + batch_window reduce. keeping it low-touch, will watch errors and p95. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploying config cfg-20260320-tinyburst v3 -> canary(5%) target=[us-west,eur-west] started at 1728804444

kira: copying the exact patch here for visibility:
```yaml
config_change: true
routing: 
  geo_weight:
    us-west: 0.6
    eur-west: 0.4
batching:
  max_batch_delay_ms: 8  # lowered from 20
  max_tokens_per_batch: 2048
limits:
  inflight_per_model: 900
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 38000
  stream_idle_ms: 12000
```

anya: quick question — why lower batch delay? worried about tail latency for short requests.

matt: aim is cost-inference tradeoff for heavy embedding workload in us-west. we saw idle GPU time. keeping request timeout tolerant so not to break long ops.

linus: rolling with canary but please add automated rollback gate: if error_rate > 1.2% OR p95 latency increases > 18% over baseline for 5m -> rollback to v2

sam-oncall: added to monitoring playbook, I'll be watching dash. if we hit rollback gate i'll trigger and notify infra.

deploy-bot: canary reached 5% (nodes: 6), healthchecks OK (latency +0.6%, errors 0.12%)

matt: good sign. watch memory and queue depth too, there was a small KV cache miss bump in staging.

deploy-bot: canary metrics @ 5m: errors=0.25% (slightly up), p95 +2.1%, cpu on some nodes +5%.

kira: seeing a small uptick in tail on eur-west; looks correlated with cross-region routing for small seq lengths. proposing to pin routing preference to local for seq_len < 64 for the canary slice.

matt: agree — update config for tinyseqs to prefer local. keep canary until next metric check in 10m, if error stay trending up we'll rollback.

anya: adding a quick note to release notes draft: "Config-only: geo-weight adjustments + reduced batch window for cost savings; added local routing for short sequences; monitoring thresholds set for automatic rollback."

linus: also posting ops checklist: 
- owner: matt
- monitor: sam-oncall
- rollback threshold: errors > 1.2% OR p95 +18% for 5m
- rollback action: `deploy-bot rollback cfg-20260320-tinyburst --to v2`

deploy-bot: applied patch to canary routing: local_prefer_threshold_seq=64. re-evaluating metrics.

deploy-bot: canary @ 15m: errors=0.11%, p95 +0.9%, queue depth normalized. all checks green.

matt: OK to gradually ramp to 20% over next 45m if no regressions. I'll update the rollout plan and append notes to release notes. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
